name: Lilith Rising
source:
Tainted is a fantasy adult Visual Novel (VN) where you play as a privileged prince that has his life turned upside down when a demon worshiping cult takes over the land, forcing him out of his comfortable life. On your adventures, you will meet the most intriguing companions and learn what it means to be a leader, in order to save your kingdom; and if you play your cards right maybe even find some romance.

A fun fantasy adventure, filled with humor, drama, epic battles, mystery and lots of sex!

[From [url=https://jubeigames.itch.io/tainted]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Tainted》是一部奇幻成人视觉小说（VN），你将扮演一位享有特权的王子，当恶魔崇拜邪教占领这片土地并迫使他离开舒适的生活时，他的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。在你的冒险中，你会遇到最有趣的同伴，并了解成为领导者意味着什么，以拯救你的王国；如果你玩得好，甚至可能会找到一些浪漫。

有趣的奇幻冒险，充满幽默、戏剧、史诗般的战斗、神秘和大量的性爱！

[来自[url=https://jubeigames.itch.io/tainted]Itch.io[/url]]
